title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2023〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone. I think that should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okey dokey! Tomorrow's finally here! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. As soon as homeroom finishes, we'll head over to Class B.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. I'll be waiting for all of you there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? What's tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll be having a party and invited a whole bunch of friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should've said something earlier. We could've prepared something nice for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I guess there's not much we can do now, but...is there anything else we could possibly do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if you all have time after the party tomorrow, you guys should come over here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to throw a celebration for you too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I would love that! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Tomorrow's going to be a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!
Honami's birthday
After school

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm, so this can go here... My bag still doesn't quite close...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I need to make sure these wonderful gifts don't get crushed...
Oh, there we go. I'm so glad it all fits.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Sorry for all of the stuff. We wanted to give you something special for your birthday, and I guess we went a little overboard!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay. Thank you for all of the birthday wishes and gifts. I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take my time to open all of these when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go to pick up Tsukasa now, so I might be a little late to the party!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Pick up Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Tsukasa said that he'll also be coming to the party yesterday, but he might not know how to get there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You don't have to worry about that, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, we'll be having the party at Tsukasa's and Saki's house after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Oooh! I see!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's head over there together, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Off we go go gooo☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What's Emu holding? It looks like a rolled up poster card?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami. Sorry for keeping you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika! You're all here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're missing Minori, Shizuku and the others... But they'll be coming after their rehearsal so they said they'll be a little late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami. Thank you for inviting me to come celebrate with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane! I'm glad you're able to join us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone's here so let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Kohane! Let's put up those decorations together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Where's the tape... Tape... Tape... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, I'll bring these plates over, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Ichi! Now we just need cups for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I can help you. It'll be difficult for you to carry all of that alone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! You're the star of the day, Hona! So you can just sit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-but, it's the least I can do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, maybe we should've gotten more drinks and snacks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too. I'll go buy some more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! In that case, I can go with—

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: You sit down, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-but... Everyone's doing so much preparing all of this. I feel bad just sitting and waiting...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why we've been telling you to sit down and relax.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then again, I guess you are usually the one who prepares everything during these kinds of occasions.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. They're all so close.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we've got visitors! I'll go answer the door.
Sorry we're late!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know that voice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori! Haruka! And Shizuku, too! Hope practice went well!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi wanted to come too, but she had something she needed to do at home, so she won't be able to join us. That's why we'll be celebrating, and wishing Honami a happy birthday in her stead!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! We also bought some more snacks on the way here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh, perfect timing! We were just talking about how we might not have enough!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please come in, come in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for having us. Wow, this really brings back memories. I remember coming here to play with Tsukasa and Saki.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't realize your home was this spacious, Tenma. I'm a little surprised.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-me too. I'm starting to feel kind of nervous!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Please make yourself at home! Hona and the others are over there, by the way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello? Tsukasa? Sorry for this but could you buy some drinks on the way home...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, this should be enough drinks for everyone! Let's kick off Honami's birthday celebration, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Tsukasa. And thank you to all of you for coming as well!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, shall we start?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cheers!
